mailCorrectionDesign.decision: No mail candidate accepted or implemented. The existing services provide bounded collection and persistence homes, but full correctness plus all-feature/cadence preservation needs a proven trigger/publication policy, metadata authority and delegated-consumer overlay. Timing alone cannot authorize those semantics.

unresolvedAcceptanceGates.gate: Universal trigger and earliest safe publication
unresolvedAcceptanceGates.finding: Second replacement in one native epoch detects some stale jobs but misses the first old-before-newCold completion. Header agreement is insufficient. Validating every relevant native inbox epoch is the only currently identified general bridge-side authority route; it adds real read work and may outlast0.2s on a large inbox. Publishing provider facts provisionally preserves first cadence but does not guarantee fresh counts for actions; delaying first publication changes cadence. Native measurement and explicit policy are required; neither choice is silently accepted.

A positive cached count is last-known, not proof of freshness. Empty/closed/unavailable native facts cannot clear a correction. Missing itemID versus true empty must use header attachment completeness plus readable scan identity; no timeout converts uncertainty into zero. Saved last-seen data must retain its status on reload.

unresolvedAcceptanceGates.gate: Corrections cannot retire on provider equality alone
unresolvedAcceptanceGates.finding: A newer correct provider result can equal the correction and later be overwritten by an older still-pending cold producer. Without a public producer watermark, equality does not prove all old jobs drained. Keep authority through the relevant mailbox lifecycle and revalidate every later divergent replacement; no arbitrary timeout proves freshness.

unresolvedAcceptanceGates.gate: Full item links, battle pets and variants
unresolvedAcceptanceGates.finding: Native ID/count collector cannot reconstruct exact battle-pet/variant hyperlink identity. Reusing a provider hyperlink merely because itemID/count match can attach the wrong cage/variant, especially with duplicates. A count-only correction cannot silently certify link-based tooltip/account results. Need independently validated full occurrence metadata or an explicitly scoped accepted limitation; native exceptional GetInboxItemLink cost remains measure-first.

Mail adjustments must copy only affected returned rows while preserving faction/connected-realm/show filters, other location fields, row ordering and provider-owned return identity contracts where relied upon. ItemID and exact-link queries need separate authority; external summary mutation/cache invalidation is not assumed. This makes Adapter+Sync alone insufficient.

Preserve every real appended receipt occurrence, including identical duplicates. Same array reference alone does not prove an append; confirm unchanged full prefix and new suffix under known producer semantics. Receipt revision changes during native scan invalidate/restart it. Keep post-capture predictions separately until an independently complete native view supersedes them under the existing receipt policy. Do not derive receipt identity from itemID alone.

Preserve original per-occurrence expirationTime and existing last-seen/cleanup semantics; no new global TTL or polling expiry framework. Do not keep expired corrections forever, nor drop current receipt predictions merely on age without existing authority. Compare raw provider/Flux expiry behavior before choosing retirement; source files assign expiry but inspected hot paths do not themselves implement a universal expiry authority.
